body.name: Discordant-type garbling
body.construction: For \(\tau\geq0\), select response-type \(01\) mass equal to \(s_{10}\) independently of \(Z\), send type \(10\) to \(00\) and \(11\) with probabilities \(1-q_{01}\) and \(q_{01}\), and send the selected type \(01\) to \(00\) and \(11\) with probabilities \(q_{10}\) and \(1-q_{10}\); use outcome complementation for \(\tau<0\).
